Delhi University PG Admissions: Mid-entry, Correction Window Dates Announced

Delhi University has announced dates for the postgraduate admissions process for the 2026 academic session. A mid-entry and correction window will open on July 2, allowing for adjustments. The third seat allocation list is scheduled to be released on July 6, providing further clarity on admissions.
